source_file: Filter records with a particular sequence of numbers row-wise.sas
notes: Fully self-contained script: inline datalines build a subject/seq test dataset, then LAG/LAG2 functions plus PROC SQL locate the row-wise sequence 8,0,1 and filter to the matching 3 rows. No edits needed to run. Confirmed correct: reqrecords has 3 rows (subject 1002, the 8/0/1 sequence), LASTROW=5/MIDDLEROW=4/FIRSTROW=3 as expected.
